description: A PHP class named I18NTranslationDecorator that implements methods to set language string and language references on an I18NTranslation entity within a Human Resource Management HRM system. It acts as a decorator for I18NTranslation entities, facilitating associating translation entities with language and string references.

classes.name: I18NTranslationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for I18NTranslation entity, providing methods to associate language string and language objects by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an I18NTranslation entity instance.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLangString reference with the translation entity based on the provided string ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLanguage reference with the translation entity based on the provided language ID.
